title: MCP ACTIVATE returns success:true but the object is still inactive
symptom: SAP(action=edit, target=ACTIVATE) on sap_cloud_dev returns {"success": true, "messages": []} while the object has severity E errors and stays in the inactive list.
rootCause: vsp does not surface activation errors in that response.

solutions.label: Prove state with inactive_objects + syntax_check
solutions.body: syntax_check with the full source BEFORE push (real messages); analyze inactive_objects AFTER (object name absent = active). activation-guard Gate 2; .claude/scripts/atc/atc_check.py.

prevention: Never report 'activated' from the ACTIVATE boolean.
